text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The stands roared over the heavyweight 
slugfest! As expected, Hishi Akebono's 
races were acclaimed as truly special and 
uplifting.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As if pushed forward by the roaring 
stands, Hishi Akebono chases after the 
victor, Taiki Shuttle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She conveyed the joy of clashing with all 
their might and the frustration of losing, 
telling her that she wanted to race again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, next up is the Sprinters Stakes. 
The days of rigorous training for the 
rematch begin—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Hishi Akebono looked down at her 
legs, as if noticing something.
